name: gravity-edit
description: Edit markdown files with the Gravity UI markdown editor, with support for YFM, Mermaid, Draw.io, and more.
author: George Samartzidis

gravityEdit.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for prose text in the visual editor. Leave empty to use the library default.

gravityEdit.monospaceFontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for code blocks in the visual editor. Leave empty to use the library default. The markdown source editor uses `editor.fontFamily` instead.

gravityEdit.fontSize.markdownDescription: Font size (px) for prose text in the visual editor. Set to `0` to use the library default.

gravityEdit.monospaceFontSize.markdownDescription: Font size (px) for code blocks in the visual editor. Set to `0` to use the library default. The markdown source editor uses `editor.fontSize` instead.

enumDescriptions: Follow the active VS Code color theme
gravityEdit.theme.markdownDescription: Color theme for the editor. `auto` follows the active VS Code theme.

gravityEdit.preserveEmptyLines.markdownDescription: Preserve intentionally blank lines when editing in visual mode (an empty paragraph is saved as ` ` so it survives being reopened, instead of being collapsed like an ordinary blank markdown line). Takes effect the next time a file is opened.

enumDescriptions: Open files in the visual (WYSIWYG) editor
Open files in the markdown source editor
gravityEdit.defaultMode.markdownDescription: Which editor mode a file opens in. Takes effect the next time a file is opened.

gravityEdit.preserveMarkupFormatting.markdownDescription: Preserve the original markdown formatting of unmodified tables instead of reformatting them on save. This is an experimental upstream editor feature. Takes effect the next time a file is opened.

enumDescriptions: Standard markdown pipe table (| a | b |)
Diplodoc YFM table (#| |# syntax, supports merged cells)
gravityEdit.newTableFormat.markdownDescription: Format used when inserting a new table from the toolbar or the `/` command menu in visual mode. Does not affect the raw-markdown table snippet inserted in source mode, which is always standard markdown. Takes effect the next time a file is opened.

gravityEdit.enableSlashCommands.markdownDescription: Enable the `/` command menu for inserting elements (tables, Mermaid diagrams, math, etc.) in visual mode. Takes effect the next time a file is opened.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:webview && npm run compile
scripts.build:webview: cd webview-ui && npm install && npm run build
